title: Bit-free complex supplier for the selected word: exact pricing, every variant negative
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"Matarener"} -->
_Requested by **Mark**_

## Change and mathematical scope

Scoped **negative result** (exact pricing + pass-model lemmas). No new κ; the selected record is unchanged.

`research/kappa01-outer-repair` leaves open a self-contained (bit-free) complex supplier: the bit side could then be built from three complex calls and κ would depend on the complex side alone. This package prices that route on the selected local word:

- **Dependence located:** in section 05 the only bit-side call is `lem:chunk-swap`, inside the packed row additions that implement each edge's basis change `P_M`.
- **Control:** the ADAPTER-FUSION *relative* compiler is reproduced exactly (232,198 / 239,648 rank mass).
- **Lazy directions (new):** a child only needs its Walsh directions to be coordinates of the stored layout (`F_r P_M = P_M ∏ C_{M⁻¹e_j}`, checked on the native Clifford tableau). Mass halves to 114,114 / 127,308, but the saving stays ≈ −0.90 / −0.93.
- **Layout changes:** children alone force 0 / 8; ADD gates force **≥ 105 / 106 per call under any schedule** (window argument). The budget at a = 0 is ≈ 35 rank units ≈ 17 changes. Greedy shared-layout schedule: 2,921 / 3,177.
- **Skew kernels (no address maps):** minimum-weight residual bases, mean direction weight 2.73; saving −0.26 (per-bit flips) to −0.155 (256-tape multiway split, one recursion level, optimistic for the 2,982 non-orthonormal residuals). Masks multiply down the recursion.
- **Pass-model lemmas:** LDS of XOR-by-mask is 2^W and submultiplicative ⇒ ≥ W/log₂T split-merge passes; prefix reversals form a basis (min = run boundaries); bit-reordering layouts keep LDS; controlled block reversal = one-control shear.

Remaining obligations / limits: interior segment only (same as ADAPTER-FUSION); savings use the optimistic idle relaxation of `complex-local-word-ceiling`; the pass-model bound is not an unconditional multitape bound (XOR-by-mask reduces to transposition, i.e. the bit supplier).

## Task and overlap

Base `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`. Card `complex-new-helper-inventory`, scope **changed** (feasibility of a bit-free cost interface instead of beating the packing ceiling; reason in TASK.json). Builds directly on `research/kappa01-outer-repair` (ADAPTER-FUSION) and `research/involutive-walsh-lift`; no overlapping PR found by search.

## Validation

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-free-complex-supplier --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-free-complex-supplier
```

Local run (Windows, Python 3.12): `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`, `PASS_BIT_FREE_COMPLEX_SUPPLIER`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=negative-result` (~40 s, standard library). Failure controls: the verifier fails if the control mass drifts, the tableau identity fails, any lemma fails, or any variant's saving becomes non-negative. Full Git history required (canonical word read from the pinned selected-replay archive).

## Credit

Walsh identities and the adapter compiler: `research/kappa01-outer-repair`; native retarget word and Clifford tooling: `research/involutive-walsh-lift`; coverage law and ceiling: `research/complex-local-word-ceiling`. Prepared with Claude (Anthropic) assistance; no independent human review.

## Open next questions

See the package README / TASK.json: (1) a complex network outside the subspace-label family whose saving does not need many non-orthogonal lines at one gate; (2) exact minimum layout changes for this word (105 … ~3,000; CP-SAT set cover); (3) an unconditional XOR-by-mask lower bound (blocked by open multitape lower-bound problems).
